payload.title: Pi adapter: Gherkin specs and Python runtime
payload.description: Specs first in features/router/router_configuration.feature (update the accepted-adapters error text; add a Pi profile scenario), then PiRunAdapter in python/src/kanbus/router_adapters.py, registry entry, models.ROUTER_ADAPTERS and config_loader error text, unit tests, opt-in live test. Pi facts to confirm against a real install: session id from the type=session header line, final text from assistant message_end events, --session/--session-dir resume, stdin handling, concurrent session store.
